summary: Bug-fix iteration verification (iteration 2). All 5 reported bug fixes verified passing on both backend API and frontend UI. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passing (auth regression, providers auto-seed, accounts CRUD/PATCH, asset appreciation + depreciation + apply-projection, loans PATCH before/after payment). Frontend: registered fresh user, verified Accounts (Type + Provider dropdowns populated with seeded providers, create + edit flow with prefill and opening-balance hidden in edit), Assets (appreciation house projected ~1.102M with '↑ 5%/thn' badge, Terapkan snaps current_value to projected, vehicle depreciation projected ~270M with '↓ 10%/thn' badge), Loans (create 500jt/6%/60 → edit before payment to 600jt/72m regenerates schedule and monthly installment, pay installment #1, edit-after-payment shows warning banner and disables principal/rate/term/start_date while allowing name/lender to be saved).

issues: No inline Edit button inside expanded LoanDetail. To edit an expanded loan, user must first click 'Tutup' to collapse the row and then hover the Pencil. Minor UX nit — not a functional bug but worth surfacing since the review request phrased the flow as 'expand → pay → click Edit'.

action_items: (Optional UX) Consider surfacing the Pencil edit button inside LoanDetail header so the user does not need to collapse the loan to edit it after making a payment.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-seed providers: routes/providers.py imports seed_family_providers lazily inside list_providers — fine, but consider seeding on family creation too so it does not fire on every empty GET (adds one countDocuments per request; negligible but noted).
Assets apply-projection endpoint reuses _serialize to compute projected before persisting — correct and DRY. Handles tz-naive purchase_date safely by coercing to UTC.

Loans PATCH: core-field guard checks any(status == 'paid') before regenerating schedule — safe. When only core fields change, updates dict is mutated to include principal/rate/term/start_date even if they were absent from the payload — this is intentional (to regenerate schedule from current values) and correct.
Accounts.jsx: opening_balance intentionally hidden on edit and read-only current_balance shown as text — matches product intent.
Loans.jsx uses onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openEdit(l); }} correctly so the parent card expand handler does not fire.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (new pytest suite covering all 5 bug fixes)
test_credentials: Register a fresh user each run. Sample used: uibug+<epoch>@family.id / secret123. Backend pytest also creates its own bugfix+<epoch>@family.id user.
seed_data_creation: Backend test file uses a per-run fresh registered user. UI test also registered uibug+1784626872@family.id / secret123 with one BCA account, two assets (house + vehicle), and one loan (Pinjaman Renamed) with installment #1 paid — useful as a smoke seed for the next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the canonical regression suite — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml` (must pass -n 0 because pytest.ini pins -n 2 and shared session-scoped user register would 500 on duplicate email in a second worker). For UI, providers dropdown for 'bank' type shows 7 banks (BCA/BRI/Mandiri/BNI/CIMB/Permata/Jenius). All Indonesian labels — 'Apresiasi' / 'Depresiasi' / 'Terapkan' / 'Bayar' / 'Simpan Perubahan'.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 5 fixes verified working. The only UX nit (no inline edit button in expanded LoanDetail) is a minor product-design decision, not a bug.
